text:
Now write SQL: join constructorResults cr with races r on cr.raceId = r.raceId, where r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' and r.year between 1980 and 2010, join constructors c, group by constructor, sum points, order desc limit 1.

Let me first check the counts and top results.
All keys confirmed. Now let me query — aggregating points per constructor at the Monaco GP in 1980–2010.

input.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.nationality, CAST(SUM(cr.points) AS REAL) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.constructorId
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 10;

input.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(cr.points) AS REAL) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;
